statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229
The denial reason code was CO-197
The patient has a diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to assess arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation therapy
The denial was based on medical necessity grounds
